results.content:
Pro Suite starts at $100/user/month (billed annually). It offers complete CRM for growing businesses of any size that requires advanced customization and reporting capabilities.

This plan is designed for businesses that have started scaling and require more robust customer engagement tools. Pro Suite includes everything in Starter, plus better customization, automation, and more advanced features. [...] Core planstarts at $195/user/month (billed annually). The plan provides users with deeper automation, customization, and more control over sales workflows and is suitable for both mid-sized and large organizations. It includes everything in the Pro Suite and many new features.

results.title: Price for Salesforce: 2026 CRM Pricing Breakdown
results.content:
Check out our Salesforce review for more information.

### How much do Salesforce Starter and Pro Suite cost?

Salesforce offers two Suite plans that provide small businesses with access to sales, service, and marketing features.

 Starter Suite – $25 per user, per month
 Pro Suite – $100 per user, per month [...] Salesforce offers three different pricing plans for its Sales Cloud. It’s also worth noting that the Service Cloud from Salesforce follows the same pricing model, with the same plans at the same price point.

 Enterprise – $175 per user, per month
 Unlimited – $350 per user, per month
 Agentforce 1 Sales – $550 per user, per month

The Enterprise plan is a big upgrade from the Suite plans because it adds a lot of analytics tools, including cross filters and joined reports. results.title: Pro Suite: Try for Free Today | Salesforce
results.content:
### Can I access AgentExchange or integrate with other apps?

Yes, Pro gives you access to AgentExchange, a marketplace for apps that help you connect your CRM to external systems and data sources. When your workflows demand it, you can seamlessly integrate your favorite apps and discover powerful new solutions.

### How much does Pro Suite cost?

You can try Pro Suite for 30 days - no credit card required. Pro starts at $100 USD per user, per month (annual contract required). [...] Your plan includes 2,000 email sends per month. Need to run larger campaigns? You can easily add 1,000 extra sends for just $10 USD per month.

Processing payments with Pro Suite is strictly pay-as-you-go. Rates vary by region and payment method—for example, U.S. credit card payments are 2.9% + $0.30 USD per transaction.
